Posting for another group member who wishes to stay anonymous
Hello mixed couple

Im a foreign worker here in israel i got married to an Israeli, we've been in relationship for almost 4 years. 

My husband is living with her mom since before until we got married, only now i met his mom 2 yrs ago (when we got married) Now we are living together 2 years as well. 

Her mom never got visit with us in the apartment (she said only when we have a baby) and I was shocked about it. Or maybe im crazy to think that because anyway we planning to have it financially prepared & emotionally 

His dad visit us they are divorced. 

Now her mom wants us to live with her into her house witch is I don't really want and im uncomfortable with it, i talk to my husband about it and she said her mom is old enough and no one will take care of her, 68 years old her mom. which is I fully understand. 

But we live only 1 minute away from her house and still my husband decided to be with his mom together with me in one house. 

Which is i told him he can visit his mom anytime it's not a really problem for me. Is it normal? He said to me that her mom feels alone she want us to be together, & even in the middle of the night that im with my husband her mother calling him to the phone & had phone call for 1 hour. Is it normal? 

I told him that what happened if her mom & me will fight or something about cooking or if i finish the job and i don't want to clean because im tired for now and no privacy if I want to walk in the house comfortably wear anything that i want, or kiss my husband hug him (some mostly married couple doing) 

which is her mom is bit conservative, dramatic & sensitive coming from my husband. etc etc. Am I too crazy to think about it? 

Now we are planning to go for a vacation me & my husband and my husband told me that her mom wants co come with us too(which is i don't know if its really normal & right) or im too selfish! Please advice me mixed couple, I got lot of thoughts going on into my mind. 

She never invites us shabbat dinner my husband is going there alone sometime i told him if I can come he said nextime because her mom is sleeping, he do massage to his mom too when I call him, i don't know whats going on. 

I love my husband me & my husband are very well, i dont want to hurt his feelings because its his mom but i think that if we leave together this will be the end of me & my husband soon (because someone will be giving some thoughts to him) i know i know i know..  i know her mom doesn't want me, I know i just know deep down my guts 

If you are in situation like me, what would you do? What is the best decision to do.
